text:
Grab has never declared or paid any cash dividends on its Class A Ordinary Shares, and it currently intends to retain any future earnings rather than pay dividends for the foreseeable future [Grab, FY2025, p.122, 123]. Any future decision to pay dividends would be at the full discretion of the board of directors, subject to applicable laws, and would depend on factors such as Grab's financial condition, results of operations, capital requirements, general business conditions, and other factors the board deems relevant [Grab, FY2025, p.122, 123; p.49, 50]. The board also has complete discretion over the timing, amount and form of any future dividends, which would further depend on cash flows received from subsidiaries and consolidated affiliated entities and any contractual restrictions [Grab, FY2025, p.49, 50].

Notably, instead of dividends, in February 2026 Grab's board authorized a share repurchase program of up to $500 million of Class A Ordinary Shares, with no fixed end date and no obligation to repurchase a specific amount [Grab, FY2025, p.49, 50]. Formally, in the "Dividends and Paying Agents" section of the annual report, Grab states this item is "Not applicable" [Grab, FY2025, p.130].
